Biohub - Cell Tracking During Development:�3rd Place Solution
items.summary: An overview of my 3rd-place solution to the Kaggle “Biohub – Cell Tracking During Development” competition, presented at the winners’ call.The presentation covers a pipeline for tracking cells and reconstructing cell lineages in 3D time-lapse microscopy, with a focus on learning from sparse annotations. The approach combines 2.5D and 3D cell detection, self-supervised dense flow estimation, cell matching, and division identification, integrating their predictions through graph optimization. It also includes ablation studies examining how these components contribute to the final system.Source code:https://github.com/yu4u/kaggle-biohub-3rdTechnical paper: “Learning to Track Cells from Sparse Annotations in 3D Time-Lapse Microscopy”https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.06624
